relationships.subject: VEGF
relationships.evidence_quote: Specifically, antiangiogenic agents, including VEGF inhibitors, have been shown to counter local immunosuppressive effects by enhancing antigen presentation and immune effector cells

relationships.subject: bevacizumab
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, anti-VEGF antibodies normalize the tumor vasculature to promote effective infiltration of T cells into the tumor.

key_findings: Case report: atezolizumab plus bevacizumab produced a sustained response in HCC after progression on nivolumab, suggesting VEGF inhibition can overcome checkpoint inhibitor resistance (single patient).
